lines: A slack thread lies at my feet
Stretching endlessly, it glows
Where it leads, I do not know
It circles around, just the same
Prepared not to resist
Nostalgic for distant memories
At last I have taken it in my hand
It begins to tremble
Can you feel this vibration?
A future answer to match the past
Strike the throbbing chest
We were drawn together, still stronger, stronger
Taut and unchanged, I pull it toward me
Bind it tightly to my heart
So even if I lose my way, I can still arrive
Because proof of our connection lies here
Because we can meet again any number of times
All the choices we have stacked
Carry meaning
There is no mistake
Even those tears are linked here
Coincidences chain together
Now they become inevitability
The outstretched hand remains far, far away
Yet I remember it clearly
The warmth that stays in my heart
Sustains me as it did that day
No matter what tomorrow brings, it stays bound
The more I think of it, the deeper the yearning
The hand I pull toward me bleeds into red
The stretched thread is hard, thick, long, and wide
We trusted each other, still stronger, stronger
Close my eyes and there you are
We were drawn together, still stronger, stronger
Taut and unchanged, I pull it toward me
Bind it tightly to my heart
So even if I lose my way, I can still arrive
Because proof of our connection lies here
Because we can meet again any number of times
